Tmux upgrade

Added special line to tmux.conf to automatically install tpm and
listed plugins on new machines.

Installed vim-obsession plugin to manage vim sessions as per

Finished blog and users

Security Fix

- Fixed issue where logged in users could edit and even delete other

Minifix

- Small fix to base template

Implemented post searching

- Can now search posts by title
- New section to view your own posts

Hotfix

- Slightly changed logic to verify if logged in user is post author or
  profile owner: used "is" (identity) instead of "==" (equality). Should
  hopefully be more secure this way

Blog CRUD Finished

- Users are able to create new posts if they are logged in
- Users may only edit or delete their own posts
- User List and profiles now visible without LoginRequired, but profiles may only be
  edited by their respective owners
- Applied simple styling to templates, so they are less plain and have a
  bit more functionality to them

Blog-Posts First CRUD Commit

- Began work on CRUD for blog posts

User profile's CRUD Complete

- Implemented User info and profile picture edit options
- Implemented account deletion

User CRUD progress

- Created templates for user profile update, delete and a users list

- Modified base urls, root now leads to 'Blog-Index'
- Recreated DB. Reset pk and id values for users so user verification
  logic worked properly

Applied user profiles, login, logout and registration

- Applied user login, logout and registration functionalities, as well
  as the required forms
- Modified templates to delete duplicate <body> tags and incorrect
  indentation
- Implemented functionality to base template navbar, now it changes
  according to user's login status (content changes if user is logged in
  with a valid account)
- Modified users app models, changed name from BlogUser to Profile,
  no longer using ForeignKey, now using OneToOneField (only one profile per user).
  Also now has a new ImageField with Pillow
- Installed Pillow, crispy_forms and crispy_bootstrap5 libraries, and
  updated requirements.txt accordingly
- Modified settings.py to reflect changes, set the LOGIN_URL and
  LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL constants, as well as those required by
  crispy_forms and crispy_bootstrap5
